# Actual CSS

Actual CSS is a plain-CSS component framework.

Main docs:
- /docs/spec.md
- /docs/ai.md
- /docs/recipes.md
- /docs/components/button.md
- /docs/components/badge.md
- /docs/components/alert.md
- /docs/components/card.md
- /docs/components/forms.md

Use this class grammar:

.component intent variant size

Examples:

<button class="btn primary soft lg">Save</button>
<span class="badge success outline">Published</span>
<div class="alert warning soft">Check this value</div>

Do not invent classes such as `.btn-primary` or `.badge-primary`.

Base `actual.css` includes light defaults and automatic system dark mode. Explicit named themes require loading `dist/themes/{name}.css` before using `[data-theme="{name}"]`. Themes can control border radius with `--radius`, `--radius-sm`, and `--radius-lg`; the `square` theme sets them to `0`.

Common recipes:
- Form card: `.card.stack`, `.field`, `.input`, `.select`, `.choice`, and a `.cluster` action footer.
- Empty state: centered `.card.stack` with short text and one `.btn.primary`.
- Stats cards: `.grid`, `.card.metric`, `.badge`, `.progress`, and `.meter`.
- Split button: `.join` with a primary `.btn` and a nested `.dropdown`; use `.dropdown-menu` for secondary actions.
